units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|You are passing through the spaceport when you see a young woman walking in your direction. Trailing behind her is a multitude of camera drones, each one marked with a logo consisting of two curves pointing inwards.|511|0
units.english: You are passing through the spaceport when you see a young woman walking in your direction. Trailing behind her is a multitude of camera drones, each one marked with a logo consisting of two curves pointing inwards.
units.italian: Stai attraversando lo spazioporto quando vedi una giovane donna che cammina verso di te. Dietro di lei sfilano moltissimi droni-fotocamera, ciascuno contrassegnato da un logo composto da due curve che puntano verso l'interno.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Wait for her to approach.)|513|0
units.english: (Wait for her to approach.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che si avvicini.)

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Hope she doesn't notice me.)|515|0
units.english: (Hope she doesn't notice me.)
units.italian: (Spera che non mi noti.)

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Try to avoid her.)|517|0
units.english: (Try to avoid her.)
units.italian: (Cerca di evitarla.)

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	You take a hallway off to the side to evade her. Just as you think you've gotten out of sight, you hear a voice. "Excuse me!" You turn to see the reporter following you.|518|0
units.english: You take a hallway off to the side to evade her. Just as you think you've gotten out of sight, you hear a voice. "Excuse me!" You turn to see the reporter following you.
units.italian: Prendi un corridoio laterale per sfuggirle. Proprio quando pensi di essere fuori vista, senti una voce. "Mi scusi!" Ti volti e vedi la reporter che ti segue.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	As you continue walking, you hear her call out, "Excuse me!" Suppressing a sigh, you turn to face the reporter.|521|0
units.english: As you continue walking, you hear her call out, "Excuse me!" Suppressing a sigh, you turn to face the reporter.
units.italian: Mentre continui a camminare, la senti chiamare: "Mi scusi!" Soffocando un sospiro, ti volti verso la reporter.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	As she gets closer to you, she smiles. "Hello Captain! Would you be willing to answer a few questions for our viewers?"|523|0
units.english: As she gets closer to you, she smiles. "Hello Captain! Would you be willing to answer a few questions for our viewers?"
units.italian: Quando ti si avvicina, sorride. "Salve, capitano! Sarebbe disposto a rispondere a qualche domanda per i nostri spettatori?"

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Sure, I wouldn't mind."|525|0
units.english: "Sure, I wouldn't mind."
units.italian: "Certo, non mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"No, I'd rather not."|527|0
units.english: "No, I'd rather not."
units.italian: "No, preferirei di no."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The camera drones circle around you as she prepares for the interview. After a few seconds, she smiles at one of the drones and begins.|530|0
units.english: The camera drones circle around you as she prepares for the interview. After a few seconds, she smiles at one of the drones and begins.
units.italian: I droni-fotocamera ti girano intorno mentre lei si prepara all'intervista. Dopo qualche secondo sorride a uno dei droni e comincia.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Welcome back. I'm here on <origin> reporting on the situation with the Free Worlds. I'm joined by a merchant captain currently between trips. Captain, what do you think of the ultimatum sent to Parliament?"|531|0
units.english: "Welcome back. I'm here on <origin> reporting on the situation with the Free Worlds. I'm joined by a merchant captain currently between trips. Captain, what do you think of the ultimatum sent to Parliament?"
units.italian: "Bentornati. Sono qui su <origin> per riferire della situazione con le Free Worlds. Mi accompagna un capitano mercantile attualmente tra un viaggio e l'altro. Capitano, cosa pensa dell'ultimatum inviato al Parlamento?"

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I think Parliament should reconsider and give the situation some thought."|533|0
units.english: "I think Parliament should reconsider and give the situation some thought."
units.italian: "Penso che il Parlamento dovrebbe riconsiderare e riflettere un po' sulla situazione."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Parliament made the right decision by refusing the demands."|534|0
units.english: "Parliament made the right decision by refusing the demands."
units.italian: "Il Parlamento ha preso la decisione giusta rifiutando le richieste."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The reporter frowns. "Can you explain your answer for our viewers?"|536|0
units.english: The reporter frowns. "Can you explain your answer for our viewers?"
units.italian: La reporter si acciglia. "Può spiegare la sua risposta per i nostri spettatori?"

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The interests of every world should be considered, whether we agree or not."|538|0
units.english: "The interests of every world should be considered, whether we agree or not."
units.italian: "Gli interessi di ogni mondo dovrebbero essere considerati, che siamo d'accordo o no."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The Free Worlds aren't represented well enough to gain traction through normal channels."|539|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds aren't represented well enough to gain traction through normal channels."
units.italian: "Le Free Worlds non sono rappresentate abbastanza da ottenere risultati per i canali normali."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The Navy is hardly defending that territory, so taxes shouldn't be as much."|540|0
units.english: "The Navy is hardly defending that territory, so taxes shouldn't be as much."
units.italian: "La Marina difende a malapena quel territorio, quindi le tasse non dovrebbero essere così alte."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I would prefer to not answer."|541|0
units.english: "I would prefer to not answer."
units.italian: "Preferirei non rispondere."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I'm not sure that Parliament would agree with you, but I want to thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.|542|0
units.english: "I'm not sure that Parliament would agree with you, but I want to thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.
units.italian: "Non sono sicura che il Parlamento sarebbe d'accordo con lei, ma voglio ringraziarla per le risposte e per il tempo che ci ha dedicato!" dice.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The drones dart back to follow her as she continues through the spaceport.|543|0
units.english: The drones dart back to follow her as she continues through the spaceport.
units.italian: I droni tornano a seguirla mentre prosegue per lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The reporter smiles. "Can you explain that answer for our viewers?"|546|0
units.english: The reporter smiles. "Can you explain that answer for our viewers?"
units.italian: La reporter sorride. "Può spiegare quella risposta per i nostri spettatori?"

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"There are proper channels for presenting grievances, and this isn't one of them."|548|0
units.english: "There are proper channels for presenting grievances, and this isn't one of them."
units.italian: "Ci sono canali adeguati per presentare le proprie lamentele, e questo non è uno di quelli."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"It's a very ungrateful thing to do when Parliament is the one protecting them."|549|0
units.english: "It's a very ungrateful thing to do when Parliament is the one protecting them."
units.italian: "È una cosa molto ingrata da fare, quando è il Parlamento a proteggerli."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I would prefer to not answer."|550|0
units.english: "I would prefer to not answer."
units.italian: "Preferirei non rispondere."

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"We are fortunate that many people feel this way! Thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.|551|0
units.english: "We are fortunate that many people feel this way! Thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.
units.italian: "Siamo fortunati che molte persone la pensino così! Grazie per le risposte e per il tempo che ci ha dedicato!" dice.

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The drones dart back to follow her as she continues through the spaceport.|552|0
units.english: The drones dart back to follow her as she continues through the spaceport.
units.italian: I droni tornano a seguirla mentre prosegue per lo spazioporto.
